questions.q: At the time of total solar eclipse, the spectrum of solar radiation will have
options: A large number of dark Fraunhofer lines
A smaller number of dark  Fraunhofer lines
All Fraunhofer lines changed into bright coloured lines
questions.solution:
Fraunhofer lines are certain dark lines observed in the other continuous spectrum of the sun. According to Fraunhofer, these dark lines represent the absorption spectrum of the vapours surrounding the sun. The sun consists of a hot central core called the photosphere, which is at an extremely high-temperature = 1.4 ×107 K. it is surrounded by less dense, luminous and highly compressed gases. They are said to form the sun's atmosphere. A continuous spectrum



containing radiations of all wavelengths is emitted by the sun's atmosphere . surrounding this , is another sphere of vapours and gases at a comparatively lower temperature (6000 K). At the time of total solar eclipse, photosphere is covered. Emission lines from vapours of elements in chromosphere appear as bright lines. So, all Fraunhofer lines are changed into bright coloured lines.
